## Summary

Salicylic acid by hydrolysis of acetylsalicylic acid. This fixture
closes a cycle with the procedure that makes the acid into aspirin.

## Reagents

| Reagent | CAS | MW (g/mol) | Amount | mmol | Equiv |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acetylsalicylic acid | 50-78-2 | 180.16 | 3.60 g | 20.0 | 1.0 |
| Sodium hydroxide | 1310-73-2 | 40.00 | 1.60 g | 40.0 | 2.0 |

## Procedure

1. Dissolve the sodium hydroxide in water and add the acetylsalicylic
   acid.
2. Stir for 1 h, then acidify with hydrochloric acid.

## Workup and Purification

Filter off the solid and wash it with cold water.

## Characterization

Colourless solid.

## Notes

1. Fictitious procedure.

## Hazards and Waste Disposal

Collect aqueous waste separately.
